requires.note: Complete converted Warcraft II data tree
PAX video pack generated from extracted PC movie files

instructions: HOST COMPUTER REQUIRED: wartool is not an ESP32-P4 program. On Linux, use your own Warcraft II Battle.net Edition data and build/run the upstream wartool extractor using the steps in pax-modules/upstream/retroesp32/GUS_GAME_RECIPES.md (Recipe 3). Add the matching stock scripts/maps, prepare audio, and run prepare_warcraft_videos.py on the output to create media/menu.paxmenu. Copy the complete prepared tree to /sd/roms/wargus/ and keep that movie pack at /sd/roms/wargus/media/menu.paxmenu. Recipe PAX only creates the SD folders and shows instructions; it does not run wartool. An ISO or archive by itself is not prepared runtime data. Hardware testing covers menu/startup and the first mission path; full-campaign, save-state, and all-control coverage is not certified.
